purpose: Negative fixture catalog for public/state prerequisite register checks. These cases are intentionally mutation descriptors so Phase 3 can apply them to the release-baseline source and assert the gate checker rejects the result.

cases.claimImpact: Every prerequisite group must identify who owns acceptance; missing owner category blocks the source.
Every prerequisite group must identify the evidence type required for future resolution.
FEAT-149 v1 cannot raise score or bypass FEAT-130 promotion.
FEAT-149 can generate a future-consumable fragment but cannot directly mutate RDY-REG-v0.1.4.
The public/state blocker must remain red/open in the v1 baseline.
A public/state claim cannot be evaluated without a target jurisdiction.
Competent external authority evidence is mandatory.
Certification or a formal external not-applicable ruling is mandatory before any future public/state movement.
Public/state readiness cannot move while production organizational rollout is blocked.

cases.invalidValue: HushVoting is government authorized and public election ready.
cases.claimImpact: Public output must not claim public election readiness, certification, government authorization, independent approval, or public-sector equivalence.

futureCandidateFixtureRules: Future candidate fixtures must be marked fixtureOnly=true.

Future candidate fixtures must include external authority evidence refs for jurisdiction, election type, competent authority, legal interpretation, certification or external non-applicability, and dispute/remedy process.
Future candidate fixtures must keep scoreChangeAllowed=false until a future FEAT-130 promotion explicitly supersedes the v1 policy.
